Addressing the INDIA bloc’s ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ rally at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi said Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar would be jailed. The rally brought opposition leaders together to raise concerns over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and demand accountability from the Election Commission.
